headline: Davis & Elkins are the last unbeaten side
dek: Frostburg State went to Point Park unbeaten in six matches and lost, which leaves Davis & Elkins alone without a defeat after their win at West Liberty. Charleston sit above them in the table, having won all four of their conference matches, but were beaten at home in August.
displaced_by: Frostburg State lost at Point Park, so the standing dek's two unbeaten programmes are now one: Davis & Elkins

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more than Davis & Elkins and Concord, the sides next to them in the table, together, and twelve different players have contributed to their twenty-six; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Charleston scored ten in a single match against West Virginia Wesleyan, more than Wesleyan have scored all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Davis & Elkins have won five of their six matches and conceded five goals in them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Charleston have won six of their seven matches, scoring twenty-six goals and conceding six.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win after seven matches, with one draw and six defeats, and have conceded twenty-five goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jon-Michael Gordon has four goals for Wheeling from fourteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anthony Fusay has two shutouts in Point Park's goal.

last_match.line: Frostburg State's first defeat of the season; Point Park had gone without a win since beating Wheeling.

next_match.line: Davis & Elkins are the only side yet to lose; Shawnee State have not won since before their trip to Concord.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
